notes.title: Build 4 Changes
notes.content:
[u]Hey guys, Build 4 is here 🔥 and here is what's new:[/u]

[list]
[*] The cards Equip System is finally here with many active/passive abilities, and curses in place.

[*] All the cards you see can be purchased and used now. The ones that are still in development are automatically hidden.

[*] There are a bunch of new Curse Cards "16 to be exact" and they play a major role in farming XP. This will be critical once the more expensive cards are added. So, you might wanna get used to them curses early on.

[*] There is a Pause Menu now.

[*] In the Pause Menu, there is a Loadout menu where you can view your build, and check the details of your cards, in case you missed something. You can also swap a certain card's assigned buttons or remove it from your build altogether.

[*] All the biomes are now included. Although there are no actual enemy variety or boss fights, once you finish 15 rooms, you will be sent to Biome 2, and once you finish 30 rooms, you will see Biome 3, and so on.

[*] The cubes dance to the music with a better sync as their logic has been drastically improved, and the water shader is improved and looks more believable, and the glitch where the water turns to illuminate white color is also fixed.
[/list]

[u]Known issues:[/u]

[list]
[*] Most ability cards will receive further improvements in game feel, particle effects, sound effects, and whatnot. But they do their basic tasks for now.

[*] There should be more enemies and more map variety. I am working on that and I am keeping the current set of maps intentionally because they are the least challenging and easiest for testing.

[*] The Music should not be looping forever. It should change once you encounter a boss or enter a new biome. That will be added once the dancing enemies are added.

[*] The freeze functionality has some known bugs.

[*] Let me know what you guys think. How's the new Equip and Swap system? Also if you get the chance to try some of the abilities, lemme know what you like and dislike. 
[/list]

Peace!

notes.title: Build 3 Changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The basic Cards System is finally in place with a lot of improvement to the clarity and readability of each card. 

[*] It only supports buying "Single Use" type of cards for now. I was originally planning to include all types. But I didn't have the time to do it. So it was pushed to the next build.

[*] The cards freezing function is working and you can freeze cards and buy them later.

[*] There is a new indicator that shows up next to your health whenever you step into the poisonous "Unholy Waters" to show how long you can stay in there before losing health.

[*] The Stamina auto refills when you finish a room now. So that the player only runs out of Stamina when they use demanding weapons and attacks, not because they survived too many rooms. It's there to balance each encounter. Not to be a survival game mechanic.

[*] After some testing, the Biome length has been reduced to 15 rooms. As 10 seemed too short and 20 was a bit too long.

[*] The "Effects Volume" option is finally working correctly and there are a bunch of new sound effects here and there. 

[*] The editor menu is there but it is in its infancy and can barely be called a "work in progress" However if you feel like checking what is to come, it is there.

[*] Fixed a bug where the enemies can cause damage while you are rewinding.
[/list]

That will be all for this update. Let me know how it goes,
Peace!

notes.title: Build 2 Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Changes include:

[list]
[*] The music volume bar works properly now. There was a bug that causes imported songs (when you press R3 or middle mouse click and pick your own music) to have low volume. That has been fixed.

[*] Switching between keyboard buttons while holding them is now supported.

[*] Fixed a bug that causes the game to be stuck in a black screen after pressing "Play"

[*] There are a lot more cards that show up between rooms now. They also randomly freeze and defrost themselves. It is a WIP so you still can't buy or equip any of them but you can have a glimpse at what is to come. 
[/list]

Known issues:

[list]
[*] The healing rush ability has a glitch that makes it start on its own without the player pressing any buttons.

[*] Loading from the menu to the first room takes a little bit longer because of some extra files that will not be in later builds.
[/list]

Lemme know how it goes.

notes.title: Build 2 Changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a graphics optimizer at the start of the game which does some tests and picks the best settings for your PC.

[*] Added a new, cleaned-up options menu.

[*] Changed XP gems from blue to green. So, that it isn't confused with mana which is also blue.

[*] Added a WIP cards selecting menu between rooms. You can't use it yet. But you can skip to the next level.

[*] Known Issues: Music and effect volume settings are not working properly.

[*] Lemme know how the options work.
[/list]
